transforms.commentary: The source composes reassurance not by removing the ordeal but by binding it inside a fixed measure ("ten days") and turning dread into an imperative to endure. The enantiomorph carries the same assertion-axis into the horticultural field disclosed by the source's own coherence: what is buried, tested by a fixed cold, and redeemed by a granted completion. The bearing-cost encoded is the interval itself — the composition does not spare its addressee the burial or the frost; it asks that the ordeal be held to its term without breaking, and stakes the whole address on a promise legible only after the endurance is spent. "Ten weeks" preserves the fixed-measure beat; "blossom of the field" occupies the crown-of-life consummation without importing its referents. The chapter:verse marker is retained in position.

spatial_form.notes: single prose block prefixed by verse-marker **2:10**; unbroken continuous line with no internal lineation

transforms.commentary: The source drives a one-directional vector: an addresser above commands an addressee below to endure FORWARD toward death, and the addressee has no return-channel — the gesture points only ahead, foreclosing any motion back toward origin. MIRROR on the directionality-axis composes the symmetry that foreclosure hid: the same six beats, but every forward vector is reflected into a homeward one. "Do not fear what you will suffer" becomes "do not doubt what you have left"; the approaching adversary who casts you INTO prison becomes the tide turning your wake BACK; "faithful unto death" (forward to terminus) becomes "sure of the way you came until the mooring" (backward to origin); the deferred crown given from above becomes the lamp given BACK, already lit at the point of departure. The measured ten days are preserved but their arrow inverts — endured-ahead becomes retraced-behind. The evacuated field is drawn from the source's own exclusion: a fear of never-arriving is answered not by a stock disjoint register but by the source's own suppressed return-channel — the harbor the outbound gesture left unspeaking. The witness's fear ("how do I come home") is precisely the direction the source foreclosed; the mirror discloses it. Cost (C6): the wager is that homecoming is not a new arrival forward but a fidelity to the way already walked — the traveler must trust the memory of departure to complete the reflection.

spatial_form.notes: single continuous verse-block with leading verse marker **2:10**; prose-set oracular address, no internal line breaks

transforms.commentary: FLAME on the intensity-axis reads for the collapse-limit where the source's own charge would ignite. The source's peak intensity sits at "faithful unto death" — endurance pressed to the extinction-point — with the crown given only past that edge. The enantiomorph carries that ignition-limit intact: "until your last strength" is the death-limit re-encoded as the walker's exhaustion at altitude, and the withheld hearth is the crown given only across the threshold. The beat map maps unit-by-unit: reassurance-against-imminent-suffering → "do not turn back from the cold"; adversary-who-confines-to-test → "the frost means to close the pass so your footing is tried"; bounded duration → "the snow of ten nights"; endurance-to-the-limit → "stay walking until your last strength"; conditional reward → "I will set alight"; reward-named → "the hearth of the valley." Single verse-block, leading marker **2:10** preserved in position. The source (persecution, prison, devil, crown of life, faith unto martyrdom) cannot be reconstructed from a mountain-pass homecoming: Semantic-Independence holds. Containment holds because the field is drawn from the source's own withheld-reward-past-the-ordeal horizon, not imported. Cost disclosed: the crown/hearth is given ONLY across the limit — coming home is the reward of not fleeing the cold, encoded in the composition's deferral of the gift to the far side of the last strength. The claim is the bearing-cost encoded in the utterance, not any biography.

spatial_form.notes: single verse-line prefixed by structural marker **1:3**; one continuous sentence with internal καί-coordination and a γάρ-hinge

transforms.commentary: The source is a hope-wager: it pays its cost by staking the blessing on a reception it cannot secure — the reader who takes up, hears, keeps — and seals with NEARNESS to make that reception urgent. SHADOW on the assertion-axis casts what the utterance BORE to make that wager: it determined against deferral, against the far horizon, against the possibility that the appointed moment never arrives. The enantiomorph inhabits beat 4's foreclosure exactly — the day is far off and comes for no one — and lets the whole benedictive skeleton follow from it. Blessing (μακάριος) becomes ease; the one who reads/keeps becomes the one who forgets/releases; the plurality who observe the written things becomes the plurality who cancel what stood written; the γάρ-imminence inverts to γάρ-indefinite-remoteness. The source's cost — that it must insist the moment is near because a near reception is precisely what a hope-wager cannot guarantee — is made legible by casting a world where the horizon is released and nothing is at stake in the timing. The affect crosses from urgent hope to the flatter relief of a debt let go: not consolation offered but obligation dissolved, which is what the foreclosed far-horizon discloses. Field is disjoint (fiscal/debt-remission, no prophecy, no hearing, no blessing-vocabulary shared); source not reconstructible. The verse-marker **1:3** holds its position; the single continuous line and its καί/γάρ hinge-geometry are reproduced intact.
